video_title: An NBA Trophy / Championship is a PARTICIPATION TROPHY 🤯

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: debating if winning one championship validates a player's legacy
quotes.excerpt: They don't believe in their one championship. LeBron's one championship in LA was not enough.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: How do we know that any of the last eight champions are actually validated because they have not done it again? Giannis is itching to get out. Boston is thinking about trading Jaylen Brown. They don't believe in their one championship. LeBron's one championship in LA was not enough. So why would it be enough for us?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Validate is the Larry O'Brien that I put on that shelf and it stays there forever. That's the validation.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Oh, you mean a participation trophy then.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I am sorry, Larry O'Brien is a participation trophy?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If everybody gets one, it is an actual trophy. You won the league that year.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: discussing Colin Cowherd's take on Ben Simmons versus LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Colin Cowherd had a bad one about LeBron. He said Ben Simmons was better than LeBron.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Colin Cowherd had a bad one about LeBron. He said Ben Simmons was better than LeBron.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: But Ben Simmons was hooping though.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Like he was still playing basketball.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You are right. You are right.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: no team has repeated as NBA champions since the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: The fact that no team has went back-to-back since the Warriors.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The fact that no team has went back-to-back since the Warriors.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: You can't even do that anymore. They have set the CBA and everything for that not to be the case anymore.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: the Houston Rockets could have beaten the Warriors one year
quotes.excerpt: The Houston Rockets as you say could have got the Warriors one year.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: The Houston Rockets as you say could have got the Warriors one year. You were big on that?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Could, that's a fact. I did say that. If Chris Paul didn't get hurt, they probably do win that series.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: the Cavaliers and Warriors dominated the NBA for years
quotes.excerpt: It was literally Cavs and Warriors every fucking year.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I am talking about with Kyrie. It was literally Cavs and Warriors every fucking year.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Yes, but there are times that both teams could have went down.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic has only won one championship
quotes.excerpt: Jokic, he won it once. We haven't seen him back on the biggest stage yet.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I will give you example, Denver. Like Jokic, he won it once. We haven't seen him back on the biggest stage yet. So people are going to question that.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If we don't see Jokic back in the NBA Finals, we are going to say, can he actually beat the top teams?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: why the Oklahoma City Thunder were so hyped last season
quotes.excerpt: They beat teams last year that had injuries at pivotal parts of the season.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: So why did we feel that way about the Oklahoma City Thunder this past year? Why were we so high on them? They beat teams last year that had injuries at pivotal parts of the season.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I wasn't that high on OKC.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Dirk Nowitzki's 2011 championship run was impressive
quotes.excerpt: His run is the most impressive to me. They did it by committee.
quotes.quote: His run is the most impressive to me. They did it by committee. Other than Dirk, there wasn't another guy that you said that's the next guy. Because Jason Terry would step up, Jason Kidd would step up, Caron Butler would step up. He was the only star on that team definitively. Because Caron Butler got injured, right? Shawn was a role player at that point. They did it by committee. His was the most impressive.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.excerpt: They never run it back. That's a difference because Kawhi left.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: They never run it back. That's a difference because Kawhi left.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That's my point. Shit like that happens. That doesn't mean that team didn't deserve a fucking win.
